The plate is about 26 cm across and spans roughly 440 px, so 1 cm is about 17 px. Each corn piece is about 70-85 px wide, which is roughly 4.5 cm across. Each piece is about 2 cm thick. The pieces are cross-cut sections of a corn cob. Treating each as a cylinder with a 4.5 cm diameter and 2 cm height gives a volume of about 32 cm³. The cob core and the gaps lower the usable volume, so I estimate about 25 g per piece, or 50 g for both. Boiled corn on the cob is roughly 95 kcal per 100 g, counting the edible kernels plus cob weight.
